## Concept article checklist (delete if not applicable)

- [ ] Registry entry in `_data/graph/concepts.yml` (status, related concepts kept symmetric)
- [ ] All standard sections in order; summary answers the question on its own
- [ ] 1-2 figures with alt text, caption, description, keywords, SVG title/desc/metadata and PNG
- [ ] Sources only from the source register (official, standards, ecosystem specifications, OID 2025 paper); new sources registered with version and date
- [ ] Facts that could not be verified are marked "to verify"; legal text is analysis, not legal advice
- [ ] Related concepts, glossary terms and requirement links updated
- [ ] FAQ entries are visible on the page (they feed the FAQ JSON-LD)
- [ ] Brand review done (no emoji, no intensity words, at most two em-dashes, Archivo and IBM Plex Mono only)
- [ ] Named human reviewer: @

CI re-checks data, concepts, figures, built pages, JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt, internal links and concept coverage on every pull request.
